module_boundaries.ARK_M1: low-power energy and thermal management bench; not a certified energy product
module_boundaries.SP_CUBE: selective spectral/radiative hypothesis; not measured cooling until experiment data exists
module_boundaries.GAIA_SAT: simulated climate value and MRV scaffold; not revenue or certified credit
module_boundaries.METHANE_MRV: event registry and anti-double-counting scaffold; not verified offset issuance
module_boundaries.DASHBOARD: public-safe visibility layer; not proof or final authority

lint_result_semantics.PASS: No blocked pattern found; still requires human review for public use.
lint_result_semantics.WARN: Ambiguous claim or missing OAK status; rewrite recommended.
lint_result_semantics.BLOCK: Unsafe claim pattern or unsupported certification/revenue language present.
